resources.string: This phone\'s health at a glance: battery, storage, memory, network.
One metric, big: battery, storage, memory or network.
device health, on your home screen

AegisForge reads this phone's own health -- battery, storage, memory, network and screen-lock state -- and shows it in a home-screen widget, in the Sentinel House look.

Nothing leaves the device: there is no account, no network call, no tracking. The widget refreshes itself periodically and when you tap it.

To add it: long-press your home screen, choose Widgets, find AegisForge, and drop the size you want (small, medium or large). You pick a style -- and, for a metric widget, which metric -- when you place it.
find and remove junk files, on-device
The cleaner needs All Files Access to scan shared storage for junk. It never reads another app\'s private data (Android blocks that), and nothing leaves the device.
No junk found. Storage is clean.
Overwrites free space so deleted files are harder to recover. On flash storage this raises the bar but is not a guarantee.
Scans in the background every so often and notifies you when junk builds up. It never deletes on its own, you always decide.
manage installed apps, sorted by size
Android updates apps through the store, so AegisForge cannot update another app itself. Tap Store to open an app\'s page, where Update shows if one is available.
